description: This file defines an interface IMfr within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, which appears to be a COM-RPC interface for a mock plugin, providing methods related to temperature thresholds and temperature readings.

classes.name: IMfr
classes.description: An interface for the mock plugin, inheriting from Core::IUnknown, providing methods to get and set temperature thresholds and temperatures.

methods.name: mfrGetTempThresholds
methods.description: Retrieves temperature thresholds, outputs high and critical threshold values.

methods.name: mfrSetTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets temperature thresholds with specified high and critical values.

methods.name: mfrGetTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves current temperature states, including current state, current temperature, and Wi-Fi temperature.
